title: Zesty Charred Moroccan Meat Khlea
description: A traditional Moroccan dish featuring charred meat and a blend of spices, served in a khlea form, this recipe is satvik-friendly and made with plain flour, perfect for adventurous eaters
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the beef to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent
In a small bowl, mix together the flour, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the flour mixture to the skillet and stir to combine
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly
Use a spatula to shape the mixture into a khlea form
Char the khlea over an open flame or under the broiler for 2-3 minutes on each side
Serve the khlea hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
